receipts.receiptSource: Original Receipt from 'Pot-luck; or, The British home cookery book' by May Byron (Byron 1914)
receipts.receiptText: 101. VEAL KIDNEY PIE (Hertfordshire) Mince two veal kidneys with some of the fat that surrounds them, season with herbs, cloves, nutmeg, pepper and salt, and a little chopped celery. Put in a pie-dish with four hard-boiled eggs in slices, haH a cupful of breadcrumbs, a wineglassful of white wine and a little stock. Cover with a good crust, and bake for two hours.
